_comment: Clock-gating and logic-depth units for RI's RCU RTL (tools/check-cg.py, tools/check-ngd.py; docs/rtl-coding-style.md, 'Local clock gating' and 'Logic depth'). Each bench is the module's value-model bench (test/rcu/*_tb.cpp) in its --cg mode, built by test/rcu/cg-build.sh at the unit's parameters: idle is reset and then no work, medium work on about a third of the cycles, high work every cycle. rcu_r is the R pipe at its one size, its crossbar helper inside it. rcu_bank_slice_r32 is the reduced unit for loops (ROWS 32; RA-32 (2)). The full-size slice (ROWS 192, M3's exit) is not listed yet: check-ngd measures it (11.4 flop to flop, 9.4 in, 11.0 out with the fanout term, 2026-11-04), but check-cg's replay harness for its 205,000-cell netlist does not build in 16 GB (g++ 13.6 GB at -O0 on one generated file), so it waits on that harness (RI's row to TI). Build it with test/rcu/cg-build.sh rcu_bank_slice. One slice stands for all 32: K and J change only its wiring. {dir} is the unit's bench build directory, {scenario} and {vcd} the run's.
